content.short: UniDerp is a one-click token launchpad on Unichain where coins are instantly tradeable.
content.description: UniDerp is a token launchpad built on Unichain that lets anyone launch a coin for free in one click, tradeable immediately after creation. It follows the bonding-curve launchpad model popularised on Solana, adapted to an EVM chain. Launchpads of this kind drive a large share of activity on newer networks.
